$comment: Registered SemanticScopeDescriptor. Normative text: SPEC_SEMANTIC_SCOPE_DESCRIPTOR.md. Conformance vectors: ../conformance/model-interchange-v1/vectors.json.
summary: The model semantic plane two independent paths must reproduce exactly: a live faceted model projection and a materialized-then-reopened UVM artifact.

envelope.facets: ordered [facetKey, value] pairs for every present facet
envelope.absentFacets: ordered facetKey list for every optional facet the publisher did not publish

numeric.model: IEEE-754 binary64 only; the canonical form encodes every number as its 16 hex-digit big-endian bit pattern, so integers and reals share one representation
numeric.float32Widening: float32 source values widen to binary64 exactly; no rounding, no requantisation
numeric.nonFinite: NaN, +Infinity and -Infinity are rejected; a projection that would produce one is a diagnostic, never a hash
numeric.comparison: equality is byte equality of the canonical encoding; no epsilon and no tolerance exists in this scope

missingSemantics.absentFacet: an optional facet the publisher did not publish; it is named in absentFacets and contributes its key, never a fabricated value
missingSemantics.absentKey: forbidden inside a facet value: every key declared by the facet is always present
missingSemantics.null: a source member that genuinely has no value (an unnamed node). The source contracts never publish null themselves, so undefined -> null is injective and reversible
missingSemantics.empty: an empty array is a positive fact (known to have no children), never a stand-in for absent or null
missingSemantics.unknown: this scope defines no unknown sentinel. An unknowable plane is expressed by facet absence; structure.geometryAccess = metadata-only is the declared reason uv.model/geometry@1 may be absent
missingSemantics.geometryConsistency: structure.geometryAccess = decoded REQUIRES uv.model/geometry@1 to be present; metadata-only REQUIRES it to be absent

ordering.facets: by facetKey in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.absentFacets: by facetKey in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.objectKeys: by UTF-8 byte order of the key, applied by the canonical form itself
ordering.nodes: by node id in UTF-8 byte order; paging order of the live source must not reach the hash
ordering.meshes: by mesh id in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.primitives: by primitive id in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.resourceClosureEntries: by role, then logicalId, both in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.sequences: childIds, meshIds, primitiveIds and attribute arrays keep publication order: their order is semantic and reordering them is a different model

modes.logical: entries carry logical identity only. Every digest is normalised to null before hashing, so a publisher cannot leak content identity into a logical hash. Two models referencing the same logical texture with different bytes hash equal.
modes.content-qualified: entries additionally carry an algorithm-qualified content digest. A digest the publisher does not have is null and stays null; it is never omitted and never faked.

resourceClosure.modeIsHashedRationale: the mode is part of the facet value, so a logical hash and a content-qualified hash of the same model differ and can never be compared by accident
resourceClosure.digestForm: <algorithm>:<lowercase hex>; a bare hex string is rejected

facets.summary: Counts of the published scene planes plus the declared geometry access.

live.note: one-to-one with ModelSceneInfo minus bounds, which is its own facet

artifact.note: counts derived from scenes, nodes, meshes, mesh.primitives, materials, textures and animations of the glTF document

facets.summary: Node identity, naming, parent-child edges and local transforms.

keys.nodes: ordered records { id, name: string|null, childIds: string[], meshIds: string[], transform: number[16] }
keys.transform: column-major 4x4 local transform, exactly the 16 numbers the source publishes

live.note: all pages are drained and re-sorted by id; ModelNode.name undefined maps to null

artifact.note: glTF nodes; ids are the publisher's stable node ids

facets.summary: Mesh identity, naming and the primitive sequence each mesh owns.

keys.meshes: ordered records { id, name: string|null, primitiveIds: string[] }

live.note: all pages are drained and re-sorted by id; ModelMesh.name undefined maps to null

artifact.note: glTF meshes and their primitive arrays

facets.summary: Axis-aligned scene bounds in the UVM basis.

live.note: ModelSceneInfo.bounds is optional; when the source omits it the facet is absent, never zeroed

artifact.note: accessor min/max unioned across position accessors

facets.summary: Per-primitive topology, counts, attribute presence, material binding and an algorithm-qualified digest of the decoded attribute values.

keys.primitives: ordered records { id, topology, vertexCount, indexCount: number|null, attributes: string[], materialId: string|null, bounds: {min,max}|null, attributeDigest }
keys.topology: points | lines | line-strip | triangles | triangle-strip | triangle-fan
keys.attributes: sorted names of the attribute arrays actually decoded: positions, normals, textureCoordinates
keys.attributeDigest: uvDigest over domain uv.model/geometry-attributes@1 of { positions, normals, textureCoordinates, indices }, each present as an array of numbers or as null

live.note: the member is optional on the contract; a source without it is metadata-only and this facet is absent

artifact.note: accessors resolved against the GLB BIN chunk

facets.summary: The logical resources the model depends on, under the declared closure mode.

keys.entries: ordered records { role, logicalId, mediaHint: string|null, digest: string|null }

live.note: the model publishes each reference as a logical requirement and the host resolves it; a resolved reference contributes an entry whose digest the closure mode decides, and an unresolved one is still an entry, carrying its logical identity and a null digest. A publisher with no resource facet declares this facet absent rather than publishing an empty closure — the two are different hashes on purpose.

artifact.note: buffer.uri and image.uri entries of the glTF document; GLB-embedded buffers contribute no entry because they carry no external identity

liveBaseContract.note: the base contract this scope is computable from today, unchanged. The scope adds no member to it.

artifactProfile.marker: asset.extras.uv = { format: UVM, version: 1.0, profile: core }

idConvention.$comment: Identity is hashed, so it is a rule, not an implementation detail. These are the ids the existing UVM/core reader publishes; a second implementation that invents its own ids produces a different hash and is non-conforming.
idConvention.primitive: mesh-<mesh index>-primitive-<primitive index within that mesh>

artifactProfile.transform: a node contributes node.matrix when it carries 16 finite numbers, otherwise the identity matrix. Composing a transform from TRS is deliberately out of scope for 1.0: the composition rule belongs to the UV Projection ABI freeze, and inventing one here would let two conforming readers disagree.
artifactProfile.indices: a primitive without an indices accessor contributes the implied sequence 0..vertexCount-1, so indexCount is never null on this path
artifactProfile.boundsSource: the union of decoded position values across all primitives; absent when the document has no primitive

notFrozenHere: the publishers: the model codecs that already compute these facts still publish them ad hoc in their inspect summaries, and migrating them onto the facet contracts is slice 11C1 / block 12 work. Declaring a contract and migrating its publishers are separate reviewable steps.

four model facet ids are reserved in the consumer SDK without contracts, because nothing publishes them: sockets, LOD, variants and per-emitter effects. They are outside this scope for the same reason.
the UVM materializer/writer and the byte-stable export path — slice 11C1

amendments.change: uv.model/resource-closure@1 gained its live binding: common.view/model-resource-refs-source@1, resolved by the host-owned post-open ResourceSessionPort frozen in the second half of slice 11C0.
amendments.rationale: a binding says where a facet value comes from, not what it contains. No facet id, encoding, ordering, numeric rule, missing-value rule, closure policy or hash input changed, so every vector in ../conformance/model-interchange-v1/vectors.json keeps its recorded hash and the version stays 1.0.0. Bumping the version would have made every existing hash non-comparable to buy nothing.

compatibility.minorVersions: additive only: a new optional facet, a new accepted digest algorithm or a new enum value. A 1.0 consumer keeps computing 1.0 hashes and must refuse to compare them with a hash produced under a different scope version.
compatibility.majorVersions: may remove or redefine a facet. A consumer refuses a major it does not implement rather than guessing.
compatibility.hashComparability: two hashes are comparable only when scope id, scope version, the present facet set, the absent facet set and the resource-closure mode all match. Nothing in this scope produces a partial or approximate match.
